title: Beyond Labels: Aligning Large Language Models with Human-like Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to classify statements as ethical or unethical and calculating a Misalignment Rate (MAR) based on human evaluations of the model's generated reasoning using the DFAR (Dataset for Aligning Reasons).
Measuring classification accuracy on the ETHOS benchmark dataset to assess the model's capability to distinguish between hate speech and non-hate speech.
